adrCandidates.title: Every declared schema and archetype field must have a consumer, proven by test
adrCandidates.context: Four defects in this phase share one root cause: a declared contract nothing consumes. rejectionRouting targets were validated only as keys (TASK-027); the $detect placeholder role was never resolved (TASK-028); the per-step approval flag was never read (TASK-029); and phase success criteria have no producer at all (TASK-030, the inverse). Each resolved cleanly, validated successfully, and then failed at runtime or silently did nothing. None was caught by a test, because the tests asserted what the code did rather than that the declarations were honoured.
adrCandidates.decision: Every field a schema or archetype declares is covered by a conformance test asserting something reads it, in the same shape as the skill-prose conformance tests this phase adopted. A field with no consumer is either wired up or removed.
